name: Run completion notification hook
description: Unattended overnight runs currently end silently: ALL_COMPLETE, BLOCKED, NO_SIGNAL, MAX_ITERATIONS, and interruption all just update status.json. Nothing tells a human. Add a notification hook fired at every loop exit path. Source: external engineering review 2026-07-05, ranked the single most important missing feature for unattended use.

userStories.title: Write completion.md at every exit path
userStories.description: Every way the run loop can end writes a summary file to the run directory.
acceptanceCriteria: All exit paths (ALL_COMPLETE, STORY_DONE final, BLOCKED, NO_SIGNAL, MAX_ITERATIONS, interruption/rate-limit) write fade/runs/<run_id>/completion.md with: exit reason, stories completed vs remaining, elapsed time, last story worked
bash -n passes; existing signal-detection tests still pass

userStories.title: Optional FADE_NOTIFY_CMD hook
userStories.description: If the env var FADE_NOTIFY_CMD is set, it is invoked at every exit path with the summary, enabling Telegram/webhook/email notifications without FADE knowing about any specific service.
acceptanceCriteria: When FADE_NOTIFY_CMD is set, it is executed with the completion summary passed on stdin and exit reason as $1; failures of the hook are logged and never crash the run
Documented in README with a Telegram curl one-liner example

technicalNotes.rationale: Focused bash change with clear exit-path inventory already documented in the 2026-07-05 review.
